This is a list of the most populous [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Municipal_corporation municipal corporations] of the [[Areoix Lie]]. As defined by the [[Areoix Lie Census Bureau]], an incorporated place includes [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City cities], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Town towns], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Village villages], and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Municipality municipalities].<ref name="alcb-method">{{cite web|url=https://www.areoixliecensus.gov/methodology/incorporated-places|title=Defining Incorporated Places and Census-Designated Places|publisher=[[Areoix Lie Census Bureau]]|date=18 March 1764}}</ref> A few exceptional census-designated places (CDPs) are also included in the Census Bureau's listing of incorporated places. This list refers only to the population of individual municipalities within their [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City_limits defined limits]; the populations of other municipalities considered [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suburb suburbs] of a central city are listed separately, and unincorporated areas within [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_area urban agglomerations] are included.<ref name="alcb-1764">{{cite web|url=https://www.areoixliecensus.gov/database/1764-population-by-municipality|title=1764 Census of the Areoix Lie: Resident Population by Municipality|publisher=[[Areoix Lie Census Bureau]]|date=2 February 1765}}</ref> Population counts for the intercensal comparison are drawn from the 1754 and 1764 enumerations, with global cross-checks provided by the World Data Union Population Division.<ref name="wdu">{{cite web|url=https://worlddataunion.org/prospects/1765/areoix-lie|title=World Population Prospects 1765: Areoix Lie|publisher=World Data Union}}</ref>
